name: Ratfolk Rogue (CR 5)
body:
RATFOLK ROGUE
CR 5

XP 1,600
Ratfolk rogue 6
LN Medium humanoid (variant ratfolk)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 13, flat-footed 17 (+4 armor, +3 Dex, +3 natural)
hp 54 (6d8+24)
Fort +6, Ref +8, Will +3
Defensive Abilities evasion, uncanny dodge, trap sense +2

OFFENSE

Speed 15 ft.
Melee +1 dagger +7 (1d4+3/19–20) or mwk scimitar +7 (1d6+3/18–20)
Ranged mwk light crossbow +8 (1d8/19–20)
Special Attacks sneak attack +3d6, swarming

TACTICS

Before Combat the npc drinks his potion of invisibility.

During Combat The ratfolk uses his wand of scorching ray to fight opponents from a safe distance. Otherwise, he flanks with any allies to make sneak attacks with his bleeding attack rogue talent.

Morale the npc fights to the death to defend his town.

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 16, Con 18, Int 12, Wis 12, Cha 8
Base Atk +4; CMB +6; CMD 19
Feats Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative, Medium Armor Proficiency
Skills Appraise +7, Bluff +5, Climb +6, Craft (alchemy) +3, Diplomacy +5, Disable Device +8, Handle Animal +2, Heal +10, Intimidate +5, Knowledge (geography) +2, Knowledge (local) +7, Knowledge (nature) +2, Perception +10, Ride +4, Sense Motive +10, Stealth +7, Survival +7, Swim +6, Use Magic Device +10; Racial Modifiers +2 Craft (alchemy), +2 Perception, +2 Use Magic Device
Languages Common, Gnoll
SQ rogue talents (bleeding attack +3, hard to fool [2/day], survivalist), trapfinding +3
Gear potions of cure light wounds (2), potion of cure moderate wounds, potion of invisibility, wand of scorching ray (28 charges remaining), mwk chag shell hide armor, +1 dagger, mwk scimitar, mwk light crossbow with 15 bolts, antitoxin, sunrod (4), tindertwig (15), 444 gp
